snippet.title: Saros - Zenith Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP9000-PPSA07632_00-SAROS00000000000

SAROS™: Zenith is out now, available to all SAROS owners at no additional cost.
Take on Overlord Rush, a new mode where you race to defeat the powerful Overlords from SAROS one after another. Choose from three Sets: Incursion Set and Ascension Set each pit you against three Overlords, while Totality Set lines up all eight in one continuous gauntlet. Post your best score and compete with friends and players around the world on integrated leaderboards.*

After clearing SAROS, enter the Eclipse Layers, a New Game+ mode that sends you back into Carcosa for a more intense version of the game with altered rules, including a minimum threshold of Trial Modifiers. The more Trials you take on, the bigger Arjun’s Crown becomes, and the higher your Crown level, the more you’ll uncover from 12 hidden Visions left behind by an ancient king.

Zenith also adds 10 new Protection Modifiers and 10 new Trial Modifiers, bringing the total number of Carcosan Modifiers to 50, so you can tune Carcosa to be as forgiving or as punishing as you like, plus new trophies to earn.

New accessibility options include Slow Game Speed, High Contrast Display, Auto-fire, and Motion Sensor Aiming with the DualSense wireless controller. Combined with existing button remapping, there are now more ways than ever to customise how SAROS plays.

*Base game, Internet Connection and account for PlayStation required to download
